name: markitdown-vscode
description: Convert PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, images, audio, and more to Markdown with one click

markitdown.openFileOnSuccess.description: Automatically open the generated Markdown file after successful conversion

markitdown.overwriteExisting.description: Overwrite existing Markdown files instead of creating numbered variants

markitdown.outputDirectory.markdownDescription: Where to write `.md` files. Empty = next to the source file. A relative path is taken from the file's workspace folder, for example `markdown`.

markitdown.keepDataUris.markdownDescription: Keep embedded images as base64 `data:` URIs in the Markdown (DOCX, PPTX, HTML). Off by default because it makes files large.

markitdown.audioTranscription.markdownDescription: Transcribe speech in audio files. **This sends the audio to Google's speech recognition service.** When off, audio files produce metadata only.

markitdown.conversionTimeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Stop a single conversion after this many seconds.

markitdown.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python interpreter used to build the extension's environment, for example `/opt/homebrew/bin/python3.12` or `C:\Python312\python.exe`. Leave empty to search PATH. Needs Python 3.10 or newer.

markitdown.useUv.markdownDescription: Use [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) to build the environment when it is installed. Much faster, and it can download Python if none is installed.

markitdown.pipIndexUrl.markdownDescription: Package index to install markitdown from, for example a corporate mirror. Empty = PyPI. VS Code's `http.proxy` setting is also passed to the installer.

scripts.test: npm run compile && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:functional

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode, settings that send data off the machine or choose where files are written come from your user settings only, never from the workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: MarkItDown converts files on the local disk with a Python process, so it needs a real file system.
